name: Musical Instrument, Hideaway
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Slot -; Price +500 gp; Weight varies

DESCRIPTION

This musical instrument is decorated with symbology of travel and carrying your possessions.

A musical instrument can be crafted with this enchantment which adds a small extra dimensional pocket to the item. This pocket can hold a single item no larger than 3 cubic feet and weighing no more than 50lbs.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, secret chest; Price +250 gp
